summary: 높은 산에 사는 새로, 번식기인 6~7월에는 해발 2,400~4,600m 고지에서만 지낸다. 한배에 알을 보통 3~4개, 드물게 5개까지 낳는다. 가을에는 아랫부리 기부가 살구빛이 도는 노란색을 띤다.

art.subject: Rosy Pipit (Anthus roseatus), adult in spring (breeding) plumage, as a vagrant would appear in Korea in April–May: crown, nape and ear coverts greyish olive with fine dark streaks on the crown; lores dusky, forming a dark line in front of the eye; a long, broad pinkish-buff supercilium; mantle olive-brown with bold blackish-brown streaks; wings dark brown with bright olive-yellow fringes to the flight feathers and coverts and two pale wing bars; chin, throat and breast pale vinaceous-pink, the breast unstreaked or with a few fine dark streaks, the flanks lightly streaked; belly whitish; tail dark brown with olive edges and whitish outer feathers. Bill horn-black, paler at the base of the lower mandible; eye dark brown; legs pink.
art.pose: standing on a rock, side view
art.scene: wet grassy margin of a stream beside rice paddies, with scattered stones, in Korea during spring migration (April–May), soft light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (spring–summer), side view standing: greyish-olive head with dusky lores and ear coverts, long pinkish-buff supercilium, pale vinaceous-pink throat and breast with few or no streaks, lightly streaked flanks, olive-brown upperparts boldly streaked blackish-brown, olive-yellow wing fringes, horn-black bill, pink legs

adult non-breeding plumage (autumn–winter), side view standing: dusky lores and ear coverts, buff-white supercilium, little or no pink, whitish underparts with dense blackish-brown streaks on the throat sides, breast and flanks, heavily streaked olive-brown upperparts with olive-yellow wing fringes, horn-black bill paler at the base
art.build: Small, slim pipit, about 15cm, sparrow-sized but slimmer and longer-tailed, with a horizontal posture; walks on the ground and pumps its tail. No crest; the crown feathers lie flat. Bill thin, straight and pointed, about half the length of the head, horn-black with a paler base to the lower mandible. Legs medium length, pink, with a long hind claw. The tail projects well beyond the wingtips at rest. Tail medium length, slightly notched, dark with whitish outer feathers.
avoid: Do not paint pale lores; the dark lores separate Rosy Pipit from Buff-bellied Pipit, the common winter pipit in Korea.
Do not paint a brick-red face and throat (Red-throated Pipit); Rosy Pipit's pink is a soft vinaceous wash on throat and breast.
Do not paint black or brown legs; they are pink.
Do not paint an unstreaked back; the mantle is boldly streaked.
Do not paint a yellow or red supercilium; it is pinkish-buff in spring and buff-white in winter.
